name: Yellow Pixels
author: Harris Kenny
description: Yellow Pixels — individual contact lookup for Omarchy (LeadMagic + ZoomInfo / GTM.AI). Joke-friendly yellow-pages vibe. Not for blast outbound. Unofficial.

barWidget.description: Individual contact lookup via LeadMagic and/or ZoomInfo GTM — email, profile URL, name+company, or phone. Not a sequencer.

schema.label: LeadMagic API key
schema.description: X-API-Key for https://api.leadmagic.io. Leave empty to skip LeadMagic. Never commit real keys.

schema.label: ZoomInfo / GTM.AI bearer token
schema.description: Access token for Authorization Bearer on ZoomInfo GTM enrich. Never commit real tokens.

schema.label: Provider mode
schema.description: leadmagic | zoominfo | waterfall (LeadMagic first, then ZoomInfo for missing fields). Default waterfall.
